lines.zh: 我沿着河底的卵石慢慢挪。
lines.en: I edge along the riverbed stones, slowly.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我就横着走两步。
lines.en: The current shoves me; I sidestep twice.

lines.zh: 浅滩的沙很软，正适合爬。
lines.en: The shoal's sand is soft, good for crawling.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，探前方的水草。
lines.en: I stretch my neck toward the weeds ahead.

lines.zh: 十步路，我走了一整个上午。
lines.en: Ten steps took me the whole morning.

lines.zh: 岸边的石头晒热了，我上去。
lines.en: The bank stones are warm; I climb up.

lines.zh: 壳蹭着河床，发出细小的响。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the riverbed with a small sound.

lines.zh: 我绕开水流转弯的地方。
lines.en: I avoid where the current turns sharp.

lines.zh: 四只脚一起划，其实快不了。
lines.en: All four feet paddle, and I'm still slow.

lines.zh: 洞口的泥新鲜，我往里钻。
lines.en: The burrow mouth is fresh; I push inside.

lines.zh: 我把头缩了一半，又伸出来。
lines.en: I pull my head half in, then out again.

lines.zh: 冰化了以后，河水才这样清。
lines.en: Only after the ice melts is the river this clear.

lines.zh: 过这条浅沟，我要歇三次。
lines.en: Crossing this shallow ditch takes three rests.

lines.zh: 上游有动静，我慢慢过去。
lines.en: Something moves upstream; I drift toward it.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把脖子伸得很长。
lines.en: I stop and stretch my neck out long.

lines.zh: 水底的影子一晃，我缩了缩。
lines.en: A shadow shifts on the bottom, and I pull in.
Shell forward. Shuffle along.
On the mudflat I slide fast.

lines.zh: 壳在响，风把它吹得发凉。
lines.en: My shell rattles, chilled by the wind.
I slide down the mudflat faster than I walk.

lines.zh: 谁把水边的门关上了，我壳疼。
lines.en: Who shut the waterside door? My shell aches.
Who buried a rock in this mud?
Only after dark do I leave the nest.
I've crawled this mud ditch before.
My den is in that puddle.
One foot at a time. Plant it.
Night mud is cool. One step at a time.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，你该找扔我的人。
lines.en: I bump you; blame whoever threw me.
I lie on the river bottom, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过水，落在我背上。
lines.en: Sunlight pierces the water and lands on my shell.

lines.zh: 壳上的花纹，每一块都不一样。
lines.en: Each patch of pattern on my shell is different.

lines.zh: 有鱼擦过我的壳，我不理它。
lines.en: A fish brushes my shell; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我浮上来换气，只露鼻孔。
lines.en: I surface for air, showing only my nostrils.
The sand below is cool and comfortable.

lines.zh: 我在石头上晒了很久的太阳。
lines.en: I have been sunning on this stone a long while.

lines.zh: 水里那些气泡，是我吐的。
lines.en: Those bubbles in the water are mine.
This shell of mine is more reliable than teeth.
The little ones crowd beside me.

lines.zh: 河弯那头的芦苇长高了。
lines.en: The reeds at the bend have grown tall.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，也不觉得无聊。
lines.en: I do nothing at all, and I'm not bored.

lines.zh: 水流把一片叶子送到我面前。
lines.en: The current delivers a leaf right to my face.

lines.zh: 这一片浅滩，就够我过一生。
lines.en: This one shoal is enough for a whole life.
This rock's perfect for scraping my shell.
My shell is hard. Bumping hurts you.

lines.zh: 我的壳很硬，撞上来试试。
lines.en: My shell is hard, try bumping it.
The water rippled. No wind.

lines.zh: 缩进壳里，谁也咬不到我。
lines.en: In my shell, nothing can bite me.
Ten armor, all from this shell.
My shell sinks, perfect for a nap.
That bird is eyeing my shell.
The moon makes my shell shine.
Counting bubbles. Got to seven.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，看我看得出神。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank, staring at me.
Your shadow has covered me.
Are you catching me, or only looking?
I won't run; I couldn't outrun you anyway.

lines.zh: 你手里那个木桶，我认得。
lines.en: I know that wooden bucket in your hand.

lines.zh: 脖子伸出来，是想听你说话。
lines.en: My neck comes out because I want to hear you.
My eyes are small, but they see you fine.
Don't move; I'm the more timid one.

lines.zh: 水面上你的脸晃得很厉害。
lines.en: Your face wobbles badly on the water.

lines.zh: 你踩的这块石头，是我的。
lines.en: The stone you're standing on is mine.
You're still breathing. Excellent.
Look down by your feet. I'm here.
Lift that foot. You're standing in my mud.
Lower that light onto my shell.
Ten points of armor; let's test it.
Another one here to test a hard shell.
You came carrying a weapon?

lines.zh: 我的壳硬，你的心跳更响。
lines.en: My shell is hard; your heartbeat is louder.

lines.zh: 我飞快的时候，撞上会很疼。
lines.en: At full speed, my shell hits hard.
Only fresh-water mud suits my shell.
A pale scratch on my shell, not deep.

lines.zh: 我缩进去了，你打不到的。
lines.en: I've pulled in; you can't reach me.

lines.zh: 这一下让我整个壳都震。
lines.en: The blow rattles my whole shell.
It hurts, and I'm still alive.

lines.zh: 我翻过去了，帮我翻回来。
lines.en: I've tipped over; help me right myself.
The water is all muddied now.
The sound of you knocking my shell is ugly.
I crawl slowly, and I dodge slowly too.
This plate of shell won't come off.

lines.zh: 你的气味留在壳上，我记着。
lines.en: Your scent stays on my shell; I'll remember it.
Through my shell? Fine, you've got skill.

lines.zh: 被撞的不会恨我，只会恨扔我的人。
lines.en: The one hit blames whoever threw me, not me.
The faster I hit, the harder.
It hurts so much my neck retracts.
Shell this thick — I can still get up.
Thick shell or not, there's meat inside.
Don't make me speed up and ram you.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，账算在别人头上。
lines.en: I ram you and someone else gets blamed.
That one's carved into my shell's pattern.
Four legs, and none of them obey.
I smell that seagrass over there.
I like the ones that crunch.
You wave it about and cloud the water.
Slow down; I can't crawl that fast.
Lower the seagrass; then I can reach it.
I'm not snatching, just longing.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起出生的河湾。
lines.en: This taste brings back the bend where I hatched.
One stalk is plenty; my appetite is small.
Step back, and I'll dare to come eat.

lines.zh: 吃完这口，我就跟你回家。
lines.en: One bite of this, and I'll follow you home.
Throw it to the mud. Hurry.
All I want is that little piece.

lines.zh: 十点护甲，壳是我的底气。
lines.en: Ten armor; my shell is my backbone.

lines.zh: 我壳上的十层甲，撞一下很疼。
lines.en: Ten layers of shell make a painful bump.
That iron plate. I can dent it.
Something fishy in that pack?
Let me taste it before anything else.
That green thing — a leaf?
Sway slower. My neck is short.
This mouth eats only meat.

lines.zh: 你顶到我壳上，声音很闷。
lines.en: You nudge my shell, and it sounds hollow.
The shell is hard; your foot will smart.
I've pulled in; give me a moment.
The ripples push us together.
Don't kick; once I roll, I can't stop.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅滩，溅了我一身。
lines.en: You step into the shallows and splash me.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，沙全扬起来了。
lines.en: We bump, and the sand billows up.
That didn't hurt me in the least.
I bump back, like a stone.
Make room, and I'll stop rolling.
Getting rammed by me hurts.
That one was aimed at me.
I go first. The mud is my home.
I pulled in, but my leg's still out.
Shell against shell, neither yields.
My shell is shoved off course.
My shell is hard; a bump will hurt.
Which foot was blind just now?
Gap's too narrow. My shell's stuck.
Harder — my shell still itches.
He circles me, shell tapping shell.

lines.zh: 海草摆在我们中间，算聘礼。
lines.en: Seagrass lies between us, as a gift.

lines.zh: 我们并排晒背，晒了一整天。
lines.en: We sun side by side the whole day long.
The pit is dug; she goes down first.
Four eggs, buried deep in one clutch.

lines.zh: 我守着这坑，谁也不许靠近。
lines.en: I guard this pit; no one comes near.

lines.zh: 他的花纹比我好看，我认了。
lines.en: His pattern beats mine, and I accept that.

lines.zh: 小龟破壳时，颜色是随机的。
lines.en: When the hatchlings emerge, their colors are a lottery.

lines.zh: 有一只幼龟，颜色谁也说不清。
lines.en: One hatchling has a color no one can name.

lines.zh: 我们下一季还会在这条河相遇。
lines.en: We'll meet again in this river next season.
Shell to shell. Don't mind the squeeze.
My shell has patterns. Do not touch the wrong one.
Stay. The mud is warm.
Come burrow back into the mud with me.
My bite is actually gentle.
Our shell patterns match like a pair.

lines.zh: 跳上来吧，我会转着弹出去。
lines.en: Jump on. I'll spin you off.
Let's watch this pond together.
The nest is under the reeds.
You smell like pond water.

lines.zh: 我叼住一片水草，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I take a strip of seagrass and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 这块石子，我先含一会儿。
lines.en: I'll hold this pebble in my mouth a while.

lines.zh: 有片鳞卡在壳缝里，我拨出来。
lines.en: A scale is stuck in my shell seam; I work it out.

lines.zh: 你把东西放水里，我才敢拿。
lines.en: Put it in the water, and only then will I take it.
That eggshell was not my doing.

lines.zh: 太重，我顶不动这块石头。
lines.en: Too heavy; I can't shift this stone.
I tuck it under my body and hide it.

lines.zh: 水草沾了泥，我还是吃了。
lines.en: The seagrass is muddy, and I eat it anyway.
This thing smells fishy, and not right.

lines.zh: 我只捡水里的，岸上的不要。
lines.en: I only pick things from the water, not the bank.
Smells like carrion. Keeping it.
Hide it. Don't let anyone see.
A pack in the mud. Mine now.

lines.zh: 壳里塞满了捡来的东西。
lines.en: My shell is stuffed with finds.
Iron — good for whacking.
Keep this one — for throwing.
Tuck it under my shell.

lines.zh: 壳这么硬，掉地上也不碎。
lines.en: Shell this hard, it survives the drop.
My shell takes any impact.
My shell's slippery — nearly dropped it.
Something is tapping my shell.

lines.zh: 它咬我的脚，我缩回去了。
lines.en: It nips my foot, and I pull in.

lines.zh: 那团影子在水里绕，我盯着。
lines.en: That shape circles in the water; I watch.
I have little strength; I can only hide.

lines.zh: 它要是再顶一下，我就弹。
lines.en: One more nudge, and I'll launch.

lines.zh: 水里那条长东西，不怀好意。
lines.en: That long thing in the water means trouble.
I lower my head and wait for it to move.
The shell is my only answer.

lines.zh: 它走了，壳里又安静下来。
lines.en: It leaves, and the shell is quiet again.

lines.zh: 岸边那只鸟，翅膀太大了。
lines.en: That bird on the bank has wings too large.
I swim fast, and my bump hurts.
The one at the side. You.
Coming at me? Saves me the search.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，速度就变成伤害。
lines.en: Hit me at speed and it turns into damage.
I've taken the mud gap behind you.
Shell low — it's charging.
Finally, something that moves.
Turn around. Let me judge the distance.
Everyone by the water, with me.
That burst of speed — locked on you.
My shell's edge is aimed at you.
After three, I charge.
Prey, don't waste my run-up.
Water's shallow. You won't get far.
Quieter. My ears are underwater.
Your sweat is strong.

lines.zh: 我把脖子缩到只剩眼睛。
lines.en: I pull my neck in until only my eyes show.
It circles my shell for a seam and finds none.

lines.zh: 我屏住呼吸，水都不动了。
lines.en: I hold my breath, and the water goes still.
Its teeth slide off my shell.
Wait a little longer, and it will leave.

lines.zh: 我准备好了，随时能弹出去。
lines.en: I'm ready; I can launch at any moment.
It tries to flip me; I press into the sand.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯着它，头一点不动。
lines.en: I fix my eyes on it, head perfectly still.
It grows impatient and starts butting my shell.
This round, the shell wins.
Running that fast — wait for my shell.
You're less than two steps away.
Breathing that hard — you're rattled.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，你能奈我何。
lines.en: I'm in my shell — what can you do?
No rush. The mud won't go anywhere.
The water carries your smell.
Climb the tree — I'll circle below.
Rolling, I go faster than walking.
Your prints in the mud. I'll follow.
This shell is worn shiny.
The faster I ram, the more it hurts.
Run. I hit harder than you run.
Poke your head out. Don't hide.
Through the reed gaps. I'll cut across.
Slow down. My shell is heavy.
Only you and me at this pond.
I keep crawling past midnight.

lines.zh: 我的壳跟着我的速度算账。
lines.en: My shell bills you by my speed.
Ten armor of shell — don't bite it.
Your steps in mud are loud.
I launch out and strike its leg.
My shell's rim is sharp, and it cuts.
The impact leaves even me dizzy.
I don't bite; I ram with the whole shell.
It staggers back half a step.
I launch crooked and hit a stone.
At full speed the hit carries real weight.
This blow may make an enemy.
I land rolling, shell side up.

lines.zh: 打完了，我缩回去装石头。
lines.en: Done fighting, I retract and play dead stone.
Fall already, save me another ram.
How hard I ram depends on my speed.
Hard shell, and claws to match.
The faster I spin, the harder I hit.
This ram — no dodging it.
Not fists. I use the whole shell.
Acceleration is my strength.
Back off and I charge again.
This move, someone threw me into.

lines.zh: 我这一撞，你盾牌也挡不住。
lines.en: My charge goes through your shield.
I'm at full speed. Brace!

lines.zh: 壳是我的盾，头一缩就没了。
lines.en: My shell is my shield — my head vanishes into it.
The faster I swim, the harder I hit.
Yell; the water carries it far.
My shell's rim meets your knee.
Second ram hits harder than the first.
Dodging won't help. I slide in.
Iron plates won't stop a whole shell.
Ten points of shell. Take your time.

lines.zh: 我撞过去的时候，自己也没想到。
lines.en: I did not expect that either when I hit you.

lines.zh: 我顶开湿沙，壳还软得能捏动。
lines.en: I push through wet sand with a shell still soft.

lines.zh: 这条河不结冰，我就在这住下。
lines.en: This river never freezes, so I'll stay.
The first thing I saw was moving water.
I was no bigger than a thumbnail.

lines.zh: 我的花纹是随机的，谁也猜不到。
lines.en: My pattern is random; no one could guess it.

lines.zh: 河湾的浅滩正好容下我。
lines.en: A shoal at the bend fits me exactly.

lines.zh: 母龟把我留在水草下面。
lines.en: My mother left me under the seagrass.
Just hatched, I crawled straight for water.
The water is cold, and I wake at once.

lines.zh: 这片河底，从今天起归我。
lines.en: This stretch of riverbed is mine as of today.
The smell of fresh mud. Steady.
Did you hear that growl?
Let me see which way the water's deep.
A dark pond. Just right.
My shell just warmed up by the water.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我速度越快你越疼。
lines.en: The faster I hit, the more it hurts.
This pool. I remember it.

lines.zh: 我从泥里拱出来，还没认路。
lines.en: I dug out of the mud and know no path.
Spinning enough to make my shell dizzy.

lines.zh: 我从沙里抬起头，看是谁。
lines.en: I lift my head from the sand to see who's there.

lines.zh: 我被人扔出去，撞到谁算谁。
lines.en: Thrown, I hit whoever is in the way.
Four legs barely hold this shell up.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的壳发烫，快下水。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell; I must reach the water.
My shell's too hot — I can't pull in.

lines.zh: 掉下来砸在石上，壳还没裂。
lines.en: I fall onto stone, and the shell holds.
Ten armor, and the fall still winds me.

lines.zh: 我在水下待久了，也得上浮。
lines.en: Even I must surface after long underwater.
Too deep — my shell's dragging me down.
After the blast I'm on my back.
Shell up, I can't right myself.
The arrow glances off, leaving a dent.
The arrowhead's wedged in my shell seam.

lines.zh: 魔法让我壳发麻，很不习惯。
lines.en: Magic numbs my shell; I'm not used to it.
This spell burns through my shell's seams.

lines.zh: 三天没吃海草，我有点晃。
lines.en: Three days without seagrass, and I wobble.
Empty belly. My shell feels weightless.

lines.zh: 雷落在河面，我沉到最底。
lines.en: Lightning hits the river; I sink to the bottom.
The lightning ran around my shell's rim.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我的壳很沉。
lines.en: No water here, and my shell feels heavy.

lines.zh: 虚空里没水，我这壳再硬也没用。
lines.en: No water in the void — this shell is useless.
